purpose: Restore benchmark-derived design mechanisms as real Production visual variants instead of generic semantic labels or shared HTML blocks.
non_goals: CSS skin proliferation without structural authorship

production_variant_definition.hard_rule: A production_variant_id is valid only when its implementation can produce a materially recognizable benchmark mechanism. A token bundle that only changes width, color, radius or split direction is not a Production Variant.

page_art_direction_spine.rule: Module variants must form one authored page, not a collage of unrelated premium blocks. The spine coordinates transitions without overriding each selected module mechanism.

library_acceptance: Every source_pattern_id has at least one mapped Production Variant contract.
No variant is considered implemented until renderer_implementation_identity is non-placeholder and screenshot acceptance is reviewed.
Shared reset/accessibility/asset primitives are allowed; shared scene composition that erases variant mechanism is not.
Variants may evolve or multiply when company/decision needs require materially distinct authored realizations, but not for random diversity.
